# ClearUX

> AI-powered UX audit platform. 96 checkpoints, 6 modules, professional reports in minutes. First audit free.

## What is ClearUX?

ClearUX is an AI-powered UX audit platform that crawls any website and analyses it across 96 checkpoints in 24 categories grouped into 6 modules. It generates detailed audit reports with an overall score (0-100), module breakdowns, and severity-ranked findings with evidence and actionable fixes. Reports are delivered in under 10 minutes and available as PDF and Word downloads in 6 languages.

ClearUX also audits brand identity materials and design files, making it a 360-degree UX platform.

## What does ClearUX offer?

ClearUX offers automated UX audits across three types: website audits, brand identity audits, and design audits. Each website audit covers 96 checkpoints across 6 modules:

1. Foundation: structural and technical baseline — first impressions, messaging clarity, navigation flow, conversion paths
2. Human Experience: how the product feels to use — clarity, flow, cognitive load, wellbeing, ethical UX, dark pattern detection
3. Inclusive Design: accessibility and equity — WCAG compliance, mobile responsiveness, keyboard navigation, universal access
4. Future Readiness: AI discoverability — structured data validation, llms.txt, agent readiness, semantic HTML
5. Brand Consistency: whether what users see matches what the brand promises — visual identity, tone, messaging alignment
6. SEO Structure: findability and ranking — metadata, headings, canonical tags, Open Graph, sitemap

Additional features include multi-model AI benchmarking (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini), AI visibility scoring, industry benchmarking with percentile ranking, predictive recommendations, score tracking across re-audits, responsive design analysis, fix playbooks with copy-paste code, and shareable read-only report links.

## Pricing

Subscriptions: Starter $29/month (3 audits), Pro $59/month (10 audits), Agency $149/month (30 audits). Annual billing saves up to 20%.

Credit packs (never expire): Starter $39 for 3 ($13 each), Growth $99 for 10 ($9.90 each), Scale $249 for 30 ($8.30 each).

First audit is always free, no credit card required.

## What makes ClearUX unique?

ClearUX is the only platform that combines comprehensive UX auditing (96 checkpoints) with AI visibility analysis. It benchmarks what Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini actually say about your website and scores how accurately AI represents your business. No other tool measures AI perception of your site. It also detects dark patterns, evaluates accessibility, and tracks improvement over time — all in a single audit delivered in minutes rather than the weeks required by traditional UX consultancies.

## Who is ClearUX for?

Product teams, UX designers, agencies auditing client websites, founders optimising conversion, accessibility teams, SEO professionals, and anyone who wants to understand how AI models perceive their website.
